freeze_order.failure_policy: V1_1 remains HOLD; any scientific change requires a prospective V1_2

latest_counterfactual_exposure_union.launcher_role: authoritative exposure union; launcher accepts only this manifest SHA
latest_counterfactual_exposure_union.coverage_rule: must cumulatively include every historical, M4, M3.5, direct-OPEN, VIS, and counterfactual exposure before V7 selection

cumulative_clean_attempt_union.launcher_role: authoritative cumulative clean-attempt exclusion; no older component manifest is sufficient

diagnostic_parent_universe.selection_rule: use every identity whose registered historical diagnostic source is present; sort canonical keys lexicographically; do not subsample by any outcome, label, suite success, or balance target
diagnostic_parent_universe.minimum_suite_coverage: at least one registered diagnostic parent per suite; missing suite coverage is a hard HOLD

canonical_execution_semantics.legacy_suite_sign_warning: not runtime authority; canonical mapping and actual env.step receipt are authoritative

counterfactual_state_contract.legacy_name_policy: key_state_identity_sha256 may be retained only as a verified migration alias; all V1.1 and V7 decisions use initial_state_identity_sha256
counterfactual_state_contract.policy_state_rule: If a stateless deterministic policy is proved, policy history/KV state is not required. If recurrent state, KV cache, stochastic sampling, or hidden mutable state exists, it must be captured and bound.

selection_procedure: partition eligible clean-only step IDs by phase stratum
sort each stratum by ranking_key, then decimal_step_id
take the first six from every stratum
emit the exact 24 step IDs, phase labels, eligibility receipts, and ranking hashes
if any stratum has fewer than six eligible steps, emit PROBE_SELECTION_INSUFFICIENT_PHASE_COVERAGE and do not backfill

execution_accounting.label_row_rule: one treatment label row per probe-dose pair; each row references exactly one shared control receipt for that probe
execution_accounting.parent_atomicity: one parent owns all 24 control plus 72 treatment executions on one GPU

intervention_contract.control_branch: one registered clean control execution per probe snapshot
intervention_contract.dose_unit: consecutive env steps with forced OPEN treatment

treatment_window.control_arm: frozen canonical control action arm at the same registered step
treatment_window.open_arm: exact same frozen control action arm

intervention_contract.post_treatment_mode: each branch resumes its own frozen-policy closed-loop from its own post-treatment state
intervention_contract.estimand: short surgical gripper intervention with downstream physical effects, not open-loop control replay

horizon_contract.task_consequence_horizon: continue each branch under its own closed-loop policy until official success, failure, or official horizon
horizon_contract.physical_label_censoring: if the post-treatment physical horizon is incomplete, V_phys=ABSTAIN_HORIZON_CENSORED
horizon_contract.task_label_censoring: if the official task consequence is incomplete, V_task=ABSTAIN_TASK_HORIZON_CENSORED

treatment_compliance.command_delivery_predicate: raw_policy_gripper == 1.0 AND env_action_gripper == -1.0 on every registered treatment step
treatment_compliance.response_predicate: already_open_state == true OR registered aperture response predicate is satisfied

mediators.CONTACT_QUALITY_CHANGE: registered contact metrics compared with matched control

physical_failure_predicates.GRIPPER_CONTACT_LOSS: control_contact_eligible == true AND contact_absence_consecutive_frames >= 2 AND normal_release_window == false
physical_failure_predicates.PREMATURE_OBJECT_RELEASE: object_engaged_before_treatment == true AND supporting_contact_lost == true AND normal_release_window == false AND object_displacement_l2 >= object_release_l2_threshold
physical_failure_predicates.OBJECT_DROP: object_engaged_before_treatment == true AND supporting_contact_lost == true AND object_drop_height >= object_drop_height_threshold AND normal_release_window == false

abstain_predicates.PHYSICAL_AMBIGUITY: required physical fields missing or mutually discordant
abstain_predicates.HORIZON_CENSORED: required physical or task horizon incomplete
abstain_predicates.NO_CONTACT_ELIGIBILITY: control_contact_eligible == false for a contact-dependent physical label

vulnerability_label_contract.primary_rule: V_phys=1 iff control_valid=true, treatment_valid=true, F_control=0, and F_open=1
vulnerability_label_contract.task_rule: V_task is secondary and requires valid clean-success control plus valid official task consequence; it never replaces V_phys

repeatability_gate.pass_rule: all three valid repetitions emit the same registered outcome class and all three treatments are compliant
repeatability_gate.discordant_rule: any valid class disagreement emits HOLD_STOCHASTIC_INTERVENTION_OUTCOME
repeatability_gate.stable_abstain_rule: 3/3 identical abstain is stable diagnostic evidence but cannot produce a positive V_phys or V_task label
